findings.evidence: The existing `pointsFunctor` is declared as `(CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w}`, and `pointsFunctor_faithful` at line 220 already works for `CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R` while `R : Type u`; the new declarations at lines 240, 248, 257, 281, 298, 310, 319, 328, 339, 359, and 385 collapse this independent `v` to `u`.
findings.fix: Retain `R : Type u` but parameterize the same-universe Hopf/value categories by `v`: use `CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R`, `CommAlgCat.{v} R`, `GrpCat.{v}`, and `Type v` consistently throughout the new block.
findings.issue: All new declarations through `pointsFunctor_essImage` use `CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R`, `CommAlgCat.{u} R`, and `GrpCat.{u}` with `R : Type u`, unnecessarily requiring the base ring, Hopf algebras, and value algebras to share a universe.

summary: The new Yoneda/fullness block unnecessarily forces the base ring and all algebra objects into one universe, although the existing API and preceding faithfulness theorem separate them.
